 For the State : Mr. Pronoti Singh, App
 For the O.P. No.2 : Mr. Anil Chandra, Advocate
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Arun Kumar Jha
 Oral Order
Present learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 as well as learned A.P.P. for the State.

02. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the present case has been filed by the opposite party no.2 who is the wife of the petitioner under Section 498A and other allied sections of IPC as well as Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

Learned counsel further submits that both the parties are ready to explore the possibility of settlement, for which they submit that the matter may be referred to the Patna High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre.
03. Having considered the aforesaid submission, the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.39100 of 2024(2) dt.10-07-2024 matter is referred to the Patna High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre.

04. Let the petitioner and opposite party no. 2 appear before the Mediation Centre on 25.07.2024 at 11:00 A.M. along with the copy of the order and other relevant documents.
